bugs.summary: a same message rollup is suppressed by any nearby unrelated dismissal because the fuzzy dismissal match does not check that the dismissed finding has the same source
the rollup marker is key[2].startswith('rule:'), which collides with a lowercased message that starts with Rule:, so a message rollup is treated as a rule id rollup
